title: Forecast outcome censor attribution
objective: Determine why the prospective forecast system is censoring a large share of due outcomes, separate legitimate point-in-time censoring from avoidable operational loss, and produce a source-backed remediation handoff only where a prospective instrumentation defect is demonstrated.

audit_observation.window: latest health window observed during 2026-08-24 audit
audit_observation.interpretation: High enough to investigate, but not evidence by itself that censoring is wrong.

required_work: Discover the current forecast outcome/adjudication owner on fresh main instead of assuming an old path.
Sample and, where deterministic, classify censored rows using immutable candidate, source, owner and outcome evidence.
Report counts and rates by reason, avoidable versus legitimate, and by owner/provider where supported.
Identify any missing reason-code or provenance instrumentation that prevents attribution.
Test whether target-unit quarantine and legacy candidate handling are being counted as operational censoring rather than intentionally excluded evidence.
Produce a bounded Codex handoff only for reproducible prospective instrumentation defects.
evidence_roots: current outcome/adjudication owner discovered from fresh main
guardrails: UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN when evidence is insufficient.
Do not infer missing market values or retrospectively fill censored outcomes.
Do not rewrite historical candidate or outcome rows.
Do not change forecast thresholds, target units, market rules or model weights.
Do not equate high censor rate with a bug before attribution.
Any code proposal must be prospective and independently testable.
codex_handoff_condition: At least one reproducible prospective instrumentation or owner-lifecycle defect is evidenced with exact paths, expected behavior, negative controls and a bounded change scope.
clean_noop_condition: The censor population is predominantly legitimate, all rows already have complete reason attribution, and no reproducible prospective instrumentation defect remains.
